subject: English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing A Rainy Day A rainy day is a day when it rains a lot. The rainy day is a common scene in Bangladesh during the rainy season. Sometimes, it drizzles (গুঁড়িগুঁড়ি বা খুব হালকাভাবে বৃষ্টি হওয়া) and sometimes it rains in torrents (মুষলধারে). Sometimes, a flash of lighting and a noise of thunder are seen and heard together. During this day sometimes, heavy wind also blows. After the heavy rain tanks, ponds, rivers etc become full to the brim and roads go under water. Sometimes, because of a shower of rain the roads become muddy and slippery (পিচ্ছিল). On a rainy day, the whole sky remains First Paper  Solutions covered with dark cloud (মেঘাচ্ছন্ন) and the sun is seldom seen. In the town and city area, the roads go under water and become unsuitable for walking for the time being. It brings misery (দুদর্শা) to the poor people because they cannot go out to earn money for their livelihood (জীবিকা). But the rich people enjoy the rainy day much sitting in the corner of the house and making gossip with friends and family members. Most of the children spent their time playing indoor games. I spent the day playing indoor games and reading story book.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 83 — Govt. Laboratory High Schoo, Comilla
